about: Claims modeled on a FHIR sample: per member, the sample's Patient and the resources after it (its Coverage), then per claim a Claim (or ExplanationOfBenefit), its items repeated per claim line. Taken in turn from the sample's patients, claims and items, as an 837 takes subscribers, claims and lines.
subject: claims

units.name: member
units.missing: The sample has no Patient followed by a Claim or ExplanationOfBenefit.

derive.about: Every resource written is a new one: a new id, and every reference to it follows (Claim.patient, Claim.insurance.coverage, Coverage.beneficiary).
The narrative describes the sample's person, not the one written (a name's or address's text is said again from its parts: fhir.json texts).
A claim's items are numbered from 1.
Claim.total is its items' net added up, when the sample's claim has a total.
